lines.text: Now! All four! Together!

lines.speaker: torvald

lines.text: Together, then.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Together.
lines.text: Together.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Keep me, Bishop. I made you strong.
lines.text: Keep me, Bishop. I made you strong.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: You made me hungry. Different thing.
lines.text: You made me hungry. Different thing.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: I only wanted... to build|something that would last.
lines.text: I only wanted... to build something that would last.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: You did, Obren. It held me twelve years.
lines.text: You did, Obren. It held me twelve years.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: There he is. Took his time.
lines.text: There he is. Took his time.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Master!
lines.text: Master!

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: My joy. Still never waits.
lines.text: My joy. Still never waits.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: A thousand years I held the world in one hand.
lines.text: A thousand years I held the world in one hand.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: The harder I held, the more it slipped.
lines.text: The harder I held, the more it slipped.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Kings. Cities. Even you four.|I gave you kingdoms. You saw gold.
lines.text: Kings. Cities. Even you four. I gave you kingdoms. You saw gold.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: In fairness, it was a great deal of gold.
lines.text: In fairness, it was a great deal of gold.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: So I will not hold it again.
lines.text: So I will not hold it again.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: So. The lightning.
lines.text: So. The lightning.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: FINALLY.
lines.text: FINALLY.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: His. Lent to me to keep you|four alive. Now it goes home.
lines.text: His. Lent to me to keep you four alive. Now it goes home.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Whoever sits there holds the world, as I did.
lines.text: Whoever sits there holds the world, as I did.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Someone will always want that seat.|Choose, all four of you.
lines.text: Someone will always want that seat. Choose, all four of you.
